title: Participles before the Noun
goal: I can compress a relative clause into a participle before the noun.
I can stack a time word, an agent and a participle before one noun.
I can read a dense sentence of scholarly Hungarian.

sections.title: Unit 2: Syntactic Compression & Dense Participial Modification
body: In academic and literary Hungarian, communicative density is achieved not by piling up short main clauses, but by condensing entire subordinate clauses into pre-nominal participial structures.

In this unit, inspired by Dezső Kosztolányi's profound essay collection 'Nyelv és lélek', you will master left-branching participial clauses with multiple oblique arguments, adverbial participles (-va/-ve, -ván/-vén), and the art of elegant syntactic compression.
